summary: Iter26 P2 Livraison testing complete. Backend 7/7 pytest green (test_iter26_suggest_split.py): /api/deliveries/suggest-split returns proper zone-grouped + load-balanced suggestions with rider_id/rider_name/orders/zones/total_load; explicit rider_ids=['nope'] correctly returns {suggestions:[], message:'Aucun livreur actif'}; unauth 401/403; /delivery-sessions GET+POST+close CRUD OK; /riders/locations returns list. Create flow works: dd-create-open opens create-day-modal with create-day-date + create-day-rider (5 options including placeholder) + create-day-confirm; selecting a rider + submitting POSTs /delivery-sessions and reloads table (6 rows, was 5). Clicking a dd-row-{id} opens detail with all 4 tabs (affectation/suivi/reconciliation/fiches). Riders page: 4 rider-card tiles, clicking opens rider-profile with rider-hist-from, rider-hist-to, rider-hist-7d, rider-hist-30d chips and rider-hist-table — all testids present and 7d chip is clickable. Regression: 14 console pages (dashboard, statistiques, commandes, approbations, audit, roles, sessions-caisse, pos, preparation, pointage, zones, produits, stock, clients) all load with 0 pageerrors.

issues: <span> cannot be a child of <option> still logged in PeriodSelector, Audit filter, Roles bulk selects. Non-blocking (tracked since iter24).
Still uses dina_tour_done_${user.id} key — must be seeded AFTER login (user id unknown pre-login). Overlay intercepts first-visit clicks until closed/seeded.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py suggest_split uses `from datetime import datetime, timezone` inside the function (line 1360) shadowing the module-level import — harmless but noisy; remove the local import.

DeliveryDays.jsx line 127 does `for (const oid of selected) await api.patch(...)` sequentially — N round-trips. For >10 selected orders, consider Promise.all or a batch endpoint PATCH /delivery-sessions/{sid}/add-orders.
LiveDeliveryMap polls every 15s but has no visibility/pause-on-blur guard — minor battery drain on mobile tabs.

GuidedTour key is user-id-scoped (dina_tour_done_${user.id}) with no 'skip-all' per-page keys — automated tests need /api/auth/me first to seed; consider accepting also a global `dina_tour_skip=1` flag for testability.
